exceptionCodes.requiredAction: Implement the schema-driven PDF renderer and compare its AIS output against the four-page source report.

exceptionCodes.message: Repeat-administration chart behaviour and images come from the assessment page, not an archived multi-visit sample-report PDF.
exceptionCodes.requiredAction: Validate page placement and print geometry against a compatible multi-visit sample report when available.

exceptionCodes.message: Interpretation templates and scoring presentation have not completed independent clinical review.
exceptionCodes.requiredAction: Review scoring, descriptor boundaries, wording, domain limitations and change statements before clinical use.

exceptionCodes.message: The source report's third-party branding is visual evidence only and is not a runtime asset.
exceptionCodes.requiredAction: Use the application's own report logo while preserving the validated content layout.
